title: Jigsaw - Jeux d'Évasion

services.name: Escape Rooms
services.desc: Jigsaw Escape Rooms offers escape rooms in Ottawa where teams explore immersive environments, uncover clues, solve creative puzzles, and work together to complete a scenario before time runs out. Located in ByWard Market in downtown Ottawa, Jigsaw offers an escape room in the ByWard Market for teams looking for an immersive challenge in the heart of the city. Before entering the room, your gamemaster will explain the objective of your scenario and how the experience works. From there, it’s up to your team to uncover the mystery, search for clues, explore your surroundings, and solve the puzzles that will help you move forward. Each escape room combines its own theme, story, and puzzle
